requirements.text: Students should be able to customise their timetable views, including options for colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks, all while maintaining integration with the existing system.
Students should receive alerts within a few minutes of new grades being posted, via email and in-app notifications, with a simple mechanism for preference settings regarding frequency and method.
The feedback mechanism should allow students to provide input on content quality, delivery, and resources through a straightforward rating system with optional comments, ensuring ease of use.
Enhancements must not disrupt the current login process or require changes to the existing database to preserve the stability of the current portal.
The mechanism for collecting feedback must ensure that it is available at appropriate times, particularly after grades are submitted.
